lines: Sometimes you are done. Here is how you leave Popkin.
At the foot of your account: Delete my account.
First it says what goes: your name, photo, phone number and direct messages.
What stays: your messages and photos in Popkins, without your name.
And the Popkins you host. Those two wrap up when your account goes.
Delete my account stays disabled until you type the word delete.
Then it says Deleting. Your session ends, and the landing page opens with a message: your account is deleted.
On a phone it is a sheet from the bottom. On a desktop, a panel in the middle.
What the tests prove: within thirty days, the Worker erases your name, number and photo. Your messages stay, from a Former member.
That is journey nineteen. Popkin is a free platform for pop-up communities.
